hero.title: Nature-Climate Policy Coherence Tracker
hero.subtitle: See where your national climate, biodiversity, and land-use targets align, overlap, or may pull in different directions.

inside.title: Every policy target, mapped against every other
inside.body: Each ribbon links two national policy documents. Green shows where their targets are in strong alignment; red threads mark a potential misalignment worth a closer look. Switch between the pilot countries to compare.
inside.disclaimer: AI-generated analysis. Treat as a prompt to review, not a settled finding.

step1.title: Upload targets
step1.bodySuffix: , and other national policy documents. Upload files directly or type them in.

step2.title: Automated analysis
step2.body: AI classifies each target by theme and sector, then assesses how well targets across different policies align with each other.

step3.title: Explore results
step3.body: Interactive dashboard showing policy coverage, alignment patterns, and areas where coordination could be strengthened.

contradictionDescription.goal_conflict: The objectives themselves pull against each other: achieving one substantively means not achieving the other.
contradictionDescription.resource_competition: The goals are compatible but compete for the same limited resource: land, water, budget, or capacity.
contradictionDescription.delivery_friction: The goals are compatible; the gap is in delivery: how one is implemented undermines the other (mismatched scale, timing, or coordination across actors).

root.title: CPC Tracker | Policy Coherence Analysis
root.description: AI-assisted tool for assessing coherence across nature-climate policies and tracking implementation progress.
